items.title: Payoneer Lands Conditional Approval to Open Stablecoin Bank
items.why: Payoneer received preliminary conditional approval from the OCC to set up a stablecoin-focused digital bank.
items.summary_ai: Payoneer received preliminary conditional approval from the OCC to set up a stablecoin-focused digital bank.

items.title: Payoneer gets conditional approval for trust bank
items.why: Payoneer received conditional OCC approval for a trust bank charter it applied for in February.
items.summary_ai: Payoneer received conditional OCC approval for a trust bank charter it applied for in February.

items.title: Payoneer scores preliminarily OCC approval for stablecoin bank
items.why: Stablecoin trust charters show regulators opening bank-like status to fintechs, which could reshape the payments partners a card program relies on.
items.summary_ai: Payoneer received preliminary conditional approval from US regulators to form a stablecoin national trust bank.
items.take: Stablecoin trust charters show regulators opening bank-like status to fintechs, which could reshape the payments partners a card program relies on.
